description: The plot illustrates how ACC (%) varies with Co-occurrence Number for six methods (Base, FT, IKE, MEND, MEMIT, and ROME). The x-axis is labeled “Co-occurrence Number” and uses a logarithmic scale with major ticks at 0, 10¹, 10², and 10³, spanning from near 0 up to roughly 10³–10⁴. The y-axis is labeled “ACC (%)” on a linear scale ranging from 60 to 85, with labeled ticks at 60, 65, 75, and 80 (and intermediate gridlines). The Base series is a black solid line with circular markers, increasing from about 64 at the leftmost point to about 71 at the rightmost point. FT is a blue solid line with downward-triangle markers, rising from about 65 to about 73 across the x-range. IKE is a red solid line with upward-triangle markers, increasing from about 67 to about 75. MEND is a brown solid line with diamond markers, increasing from about 71 to about 80. MEMIT is a purple solid line with pentagon markers, rising from about 70 to about 78. ROME is a green solid line with square markers, increasing from about 74 at the leftmost point to about 84 at the rightmost point, with intermediate points around 79 and 82 as x increases.
